text:
marta: small a11y sweep on the dashboard header update — two quick asks: focus order for the new search+filters row, and contrast on the active tab underline in dark mode. screenshot: https://img.redwood.ai/UX/header-v2.png

leo: quick pass: focus jumps from search straight to the profile avatar, skipping the filter button. Likely DOM vs visual order mismatch. Recommend ensuring DOM order equals visual tab order or use tabindex adjustments.

nora: noticed the underline token `--brand-5` is 2.7:1 on dark. For non-text interactive indicator we want >=3:1. Suggest `--brand-7` or increase thickness to 2px.

ash: screen reader note: the filter button is icon-only and has `aria-label="Filters"` but when opened the panel doesn't get `role="dialog"` or focus trap. Need role and focus restore to trigger.

marta: can we add a skip link target for the dashboard main list? users deep-linking should be able to skip header clutter. We already have `.sr-skip` util.

leo: I can ship the DOM reorder and skip link today. nora, can you propose the new token value?

nora: will file UX-5012 for underline contrast + focus-ring thickness. ash, I'll add dialog role suggestion in UX-5013 for the filter panel.

aria-check: automated scan on branch `header-v2` found 3 issues: focus order, contrast underline, missing dialog role. Report: https://ci.redwood.ai/a11y/header/2350001111

marta: thanks all. small timeline ask — want this in canary by EOD. Tag @leo when PR is up.
